name: Chronos Gear Garden
description: A surreal garden where massive brass gears intertwine with blooming vines, each gear turning slowly to reveal hidden blossoms that glow with an inner light.
prompt: Wide-angle view of a fantastical garden at twilight, enormous ornate brass gears of varying sizes embedded in the earth, intertwined with luminous vines and exotic flowers that emit soft bioluminescence. Gears have intricate engravings, some partially covered in moss. Ambient light from a low horizon casts long shadows, subtle firefly particles drift. Hyper‑realistic, cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, depth of field.
caption: Time doesn’t just tick — it blossoms. 🌿⚙️ #ChronosGearGarden
